## Summary

Describe the systems or research question addressed by this change.

## Evidence level

- [ ] Unit or structural validation
- [ ] Sensitivity / analytical result
- [ ] SimGrid replay
- [ ] Calibrated target prediction
- [ ] Measured target hardware result

## Validation

List the commands run and their outcomes.

## Claim-safety checklist

- [ ] Assumptions and measured inputs are clearly separated.
- [ ] Model, precision, target, and execution mode are recorded.
- [ ] New generated artifacts are minimal and reproducible.
- [ ] No model weights, secrets, private manuals, or machine identifiers are included.
